frames.base: kin.py base frame, mm. MAT_Z = -38.3 mm is the TCP z when the TCP touches the mat (app/tools/kin.py:24).
frames.mat: x image-right, y toward base (measure_scene.py convention). Depth-derived positions use this frame.
frames.depth_cameras: top 848x480 (fx 665.55 at HFOV 65 deg nominal); close 424x240 (fx 332.77). Colour 640x480. Colour-to-depth FOV alignment NOT verified.

mat.surface_z_status: MEASURED (repo constant; app/tools/kin.py:24; calibration note kin.py:5)
mat.plane_status: MEASURED (RANSAC plane fit, 2.5 mm threshold). Camera-to-mat values, not base-to-mat.

plates.separation_status: UNRESOLVED. The depth methods disagree with each other and with PLATES_XY.

bricks.footprint_status: MEASURED, noisy. Long side 30.1-31.6 mm; short side 25.9-30.4 mm (blobs read low). Used value 31.7 mm is the task spec.
bricks.height_status: MEASURED 18.5-19.3 mm (3 blobs). Used value 19.2 mm is from docs/SPOT-GRASP-DEPTH.md:14 ('true 19.2 mm'). Only 19.29 lies inside the SPOT measured range 19.0-19.5.
bricks.density_status: ASSUMED. ABS base resin (plasticsintl ABS data sheet, ASTM D 792). Brick material NOT verified.
bricks.mass_status: ASSUMED upper bound: solid 31.7 x 31.7 x 19.2 mm at 1.04 g/cm3. NOT weighed. Real bricks are likely hollow.
bricks.friction_status: ASSUMED. plasticsintl ABS dynamic COF 0.35 (counterpart not stated). scidar 184.pdf gives dry ABS vs steel about 0.3-0.35. Mat material NOT identified.
bricks.depth_centres_status: MEASURED. The colour of each depth blob is NOT matched to a colour.
bricks.layout_status: NOMINAL. Four bricks placed as in ep_0001 pre_top.jpg (visual). Base-frame positions NOT measured.

lighting.note: Image-derived only. Not photometric; no colour-temperature measurement. Gray-world gains near 1.0 mean near-neutral white balance in these frames.
